facility_scope: licensed hospitals and included infirmaries in the analysis facility table
interpretation: This is an estimate under the configured transport assumptions, population allocation and licensed hospital/infirmary inventory. It estimates the number of residents modeled as outside the 30-minute hospital threshold; it is not a count of patients who failed to obtain care. Where the supplied DOH reference figure is available, compare it with this estimate as an external check after the travel-time calculation.

reference_comparison.description: Compare the modeled population beyond 30 minutes from a hospital with the supplied DOH reference figure, where definitions and geographic scope align.
